Sofia (Design): Quick design check: debating tooltip vs modal for explaining SSO enforcement in the invite drawer. Tooltip is less intrusive, modal gives better keyboard accessibility. Mock: https://redwood.design/s/ssotooltip-vs-modal.png :thinking:

Kei (Frontend): Tooltip is easiest to ship but accessibility caveats: tooltips aren't focusable by default. If we do tooltip, add a small button with aria-describedby that opens a tooltip element on hover/focus. Modal requires focus trap but is clearer for keyboard users.

Rae (A11y): My vote is modal (small, non-blocking) because keyboard users need an explicit control to open explanatory text. If modal, use role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and ensure Escape closes it. For tooltip option, create an info button that toggles an inline expandable region (aria-expanded) — that works too. Also color contrast: current light-pill fails AA.

Jordan (PM): Product constraints: we must show SSO enforcement state before a user clicks Invite. Also, we cannot let per-invite toggles bypass org enforcement. Copy needs to be explicit: when enforced show "SSO required for new accounts" under CTA. If user tries to toggle and it's disabled, show inline hint: "SSO enforced at org level — cannot be changed here." Keep it short.

Sofia (Design): Proposal: use an info button that opens a small dialog (not full-screen modal) with the one-liner + link to docs. That gives discoverability and keyboard access without being heavy. Will update mock with reduced-motion variant.

Kei (Frontend): Implementation plan: info button with aria-controls -> small dialog element that becomes visible and gets focus. Use focus-trap library for the dialog. Fallback: if JS fails, show the explanatory text inline (so it's never hidden). I'll also add aria-describedby from the submit button to the SSO microcopy.

Rae (A11y): Good. Also ensure the info button has an accessible name: title="SSO enforcement details" and visible focus ring on the icon. For announcements, when enforcement state resolves asynchronously announce via aria-live: "SSO enforcement: on" or "off".

Jordan (PM): Analytics: sso_info_opened, sso_toggle_attempt_blocked, invite_submit_with_sso. We want to measure how often folks hit the block and whether the docs link reduces confusion.

Bot:preview: ssotooltip-modal preview built  https://staging.redwood/preview/ssotooltip-modal (sha: pqr654) :white_check_mark:

Kei (Frontend): Ran quick axe: two items: pill contrast on hover and missing aria-label on the close button in the dialog. Will fix and push. Small UX nit: because of the compact drawer height, the dialog should be anchored and not cover the email input.

Sofia (Design): I'll nudge layout so the dialog pops to the right of the info button and not center-screen. Will post updated frames with alt text for PR.

Rae (A11y): Once PR is up I'll run NVDA. If anything blocks keyboard discoverability we'll revert to inline text.

Jordan (PM): Target next sprint if a11y checks pass. Thanks all :raised_hands:
